title: Kasubody SMP
description: Kasubody SMP - Lore & Roleplay Focused Recording Server | Survival 26.1 Fabric with dragons, voice chat & epic builds!
body:
### Kasubody SMP 

**IP:** play.kasubody.com

Kasubody SMP is a high-performance semi-vanilla survival server on Fabric 26.1. We carefully selected mods that significantly improve the experience while keeping the core vanilla feel.

### Important Information:
The server is connected to our Discord through **Simple Discord Link**.  
Even if you play cracked/offline mode, **Discord verification is mandatory** to join the server.

### Simple Rules:
- Respect all players
- Use voice chat responsibly

If you're looking for a beautiful survival server with big medieval builds, cool dragons, voice chat, great performance and nice visuals, this is the server for you!

**IP: play.kasubody.com**

Come build, explore and have fun with us!
